description:
Exact details of Beamline elements: the import, required and typed props, states, keyboard, motion, the parts to style and working examples to copy.
Call it for every element you chose, blocks included, before writing code with it; never guess props. Many ids come back in parts: call again with the same ids and the next part. A block's compose: lines list the parts it is built from, your kit when it fits only partly. Examples use gallery data; pass your own records in the documented types. A 🔒 element returns its description and uses, without code or props. Not for choosing elements: that is beamline_capabilities.

part.description: Which part, when many elements come back in parts (each part names the next).
